title: Resolution urging MTA to lower resident rebate tolls for motorcycles
summary: This resolution calls on the Metropolitan Transportation Authority to charge motorcycles enrolled in its Resident Rebate Program a lower effective toll than passenger vehicles when crossing MTA bridges. It notes that motorcycles already pay lower standard tolls on the Verrazzano-Narrows and Marine Parkway bridges but are charged the same rate as cars once enrolled in the rebate program. The resolution argues motorcycles cause less wear on infrastructure and get better fuel economy, averaging 44 miles per gallon compared to 25.6 for cars.
